promptEs: ¿Cómo se deletrea la escala de Do menor melódica?
explanationEs: Do menor melódica ascendente se deletrea C D Eb F G A B C con el sexto y el séptimo grados elevados.
choices: C D Eb F G Ab B C
C D Eb F G Ab Bb C
C D Eb F G A B C
promptEn: How do you spell the C melodic minor scale?
explanationEn: Ascending C melodic minor is spelled C D Eb F G A B C with the sixth and seventh degrees raised.
choicesEn: C D Eb F G Ab B C
C D Eb F G Ab Bb C
C D Eb F G A B C
